objective: A large, ordered adjective list plus the agreement rules the book states outright. This is the vocabulary that turns bare naming into description.

grammar.body: The book gives the rules of agreement in ʿāmmiyye directly: the adjective follows its noun and matches it. Definite noun, definite adjective — البيت الكبير, not البيت كبير (which is a whole sentence, "the house is big").
